headline: A 2001 order allowed waivers of pay-reduction rules for CIA retirees who return to work for the government.
what_it_does: This order deals with the dual compensation rules in the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement Act of 1964. These rules generally reduce the pay of a retiree who is rehired by the government while also collecting a retirement annuity. Based on its title, the order allows those rules to be waived, so some rehired CIA retirees could keep more of their combined pay and retirement benefits. No summary was provided, so the exact scope and conditions of the waiver are not clear.

who_it_affects.group: Retired CIA employees rehired by the federal government
who_it_affects.how: They may be able to receive both their salary and their CIA retirement annuity without the usual reduction.
The agency may find it easier to bring back experienced retired staff.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 27, 2001; the specific effective date is not stated in the available material.
